items.problem: Copied UWP sample code emits ~12 CS8618/CS8600/CS8602 nullable warnings under the scaffold's <Nullable>enable</Nullable>, chased down file-by-file.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 2522-2556 (warning list), 2563 (agent comment), 1971/1986/2001 (MainPage.Current! fixes); skill-coverage-gaps.json item 2.
items.root_cause: The nullable note in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md only illustrated the App.MainWindow field; it did not state that ALL copied UWP code (static back-pointers, unset auto-props, sender/e casts) predictably trips CS86xx under the nullable-enabled scaffold.
items.change: Generalized the existing nullable note (no new topic) to enumerate the three recurring warning shapes and their idiomatic fixes: framework-guaranteed statics → null-forgive (`MainPage.Current!`); unset auto-props → nullable/`required`; casts → null-check/forgive. Notes these are non-fatal but should be cleared for a clean validator run.
items.expected_effect: Agents clear all nullable residue in one pass instead of per-warning spelunking.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 reports 0 warnings on first validation and the build log shows fewer per-warning fix iterations.

deferred_to_human: CredentialPicker.PickAsync (and other hardware/OS-gated system dialogs) no-op / throw COMException in the headless capture environment. This is an eval-environment gate, not a migration defect; no migration-skill change is appropriate. Note for harness owners if behavioral goldens for such APIs are ever needed.
